# Josons Spices

> Family-run wholesale supplier of whole spices, nuts, beans and Ayurvedic raw materials, based in Aluva, Kerala, India. Prices on request. Enquiries by WhatsApp +91 94470 29905, phone +91 484 262 3585 or manudparakkal@hotmail.com.

The catalogue has 68 products. Product names are shown in 12 Indian languages. Brochures are available as PDF in English and 12 Indian languages.

## Pages
- [Catalogue and enquiry](https://josons.pages.dev/#catalogue): all products, search in any language, enquiry cart that sends one WhatsApp message

## Spices & Roots
- Alleppey Turmeric: Curcuma longa
- Black Pepper: Piper nigrum
- Long Pepper: Piper longum
- Chavya (Pepper Stem): Piper chaba (syn. P. retrofractum), stems
- Allspice: Pimenta dioica
- Cloves: Syzygium aromaticum
- Mace Flower: Whole mace
- Mace Slice: Ordinary · slice
- Nutmeg: Whole, shelled
- Nutmeg with Shell: Whole, in shell
- Nutmeg Splits: Second quality · splits
- Nutmeg Shell Seconds: Extraction quality
- Wild Turmeric: Curcuma aromatica
- Ambahaldi: Boiled & dried
- Galangal Root: Alpinia galanga
- Zedoary: Curcuma zedoaria
- Kudampuli (Malabar Tamarind): Garcinia gummi-gutta
- Cinnamon: Bark
- Dry Ginger: Zingiber officinale
- Cardamom: Dry · green
- Cardamom Seeds: Decorticated seeds
- Green Pepper: Piper nigrum · green
- White Pepper: Piper nigrum · white
- Star Anise: Illicium verum
- Vanilla: Vanilla planifolia · beans
- Black Sesame: Sesamum indicum
- Bay Leaf: Cinnamomum tamala
- Clove Stem: Clove sticks
- Tamarind (Seedless): Cleaned, seedless
- Tamarind (with Seed): Whole pods, seeded
- Tamarind Seed: Tamarindus indica

## Nuts & Beans
- Arecanut: Whole, first quality
- Badala Arecanut: Second quality
- Mysore Arecanut: Pooja grade · small
- Coffee Beans: Clean green beans
- Coffee with Shell: Whole dried cherry
- Cocoa Beans: Theobroma cacao
- Raw Cashew: Anacardium occidentale
- Cotton Seed: Gossypium spp.
- Rubber Seed: Hevea brasiliensis
- Cashew Kernels: Shelled kernels
- Arecanut with Husk (Adakka Thondan): Whole, with husk
- Cocoa Pods: Fresh pods (pacha)

## Ayurvedic & Herbal
- Samudraphal: Barringtonia acutangula
- Triphal: Zanthoxylum rhetsa
- Poolamuttu: No. 1 grade
- Marotty Kuru: Hydnocarpus pentandrus
- Nux Vomica: Strychnos nux-vomica
- Cocculus Seeds: Anamirta cocculus
- Varigar: 
- Rampatri: Myristica malabarica (aril)
- Ramgot: Myristica malabarica (seed)
- Madhana Poo: Cycas circinalis
- Gotti Nagkesar: Mammea longifolia? / Mesua ferrea?
- Chittaratta (Lesser Galangal): Alpinia calcarata
- Maramanjal (Tree Turmeric): Coscinium fenestratum
- Idampiri Valampiri: Helicteres isora
- Soapnut (Reetha): Sapindus spp.
- Shikakai: Acacia concinna
- Thethankottai (Clearing Nut): Strychnos potatorum
- Neervalam (Croton Seed): Croton tiglium
- Padakizhangu (Pareira Root): Cyclea peltata
- Dry Amla (Nellikka): Phyllanthus emblica
- Pachotti Tholi (Lodhra Bark): Symplocos racemosa
- Koova Starch (Arrowroot): Powder
- Black Dammar (Thelli): Canarium strictum · resin
- Marotti Oil (Chalmogra Oil): Hydnocarpus oil
- Silk Cotton (Panchi): Kapok floss
